answer: At minting every identity posts 3,000 POA into a cohort escrow shared by all names registered that epoch, and the registry keeps a public mirror of each cohort's roll. If confirmed fakes exceed one fifth of a cohort, a raven alarm posts and the fund burns the fakes' deposits first, survivors topping up pro rata. A 100-clone farm detonates its own reef of collateral - 300,000 POA - while clean cohorts never pay a coin.
